citation.authors: Tura A, Göbl C, Vardarli I, et al.
citation.title: Insulin clearance and incretin hormones following oral and “isoglycemic” intravenous glucose in type 2 diabetes patients under different antidiabetic treatments

reported.what: Table 1: basal and mean plasma glucose, insulin, C-peptide, total and intact GLP-1 and GIP in the OGTT and the isoglycemic IV glucose infusion, all 20 patients with type 2 diabetes (mean ± SE); the table is not split by treatment (Study 1 had four treatment periods: sitagliptin, metformin, both, placebo) and no healthy or non-diabetic group is reported
Study 2: patients with basal insulin-treated type 2 diabetes given GLP-1, GIP, both or placebo intravenously

location.quote: The patients were 9 males and 3 females, were 61 ± 3 years old, and had a BMI of 30 ± 1 kg/m2; HbA1c was 7.3 ± 0.4%, (56 ± 4 mmol/mol) and known diabetes duration was 7 ± 2 years.

detail: Every group in the paper (both studies) has type 2 diabetes on antidiabetic treatment, which the model cannot represent, and no healthy or non-diabetic group or baseline is reported.
